name: cyclops-fresheye
description: Fresh eyes on your work: the same model reviews it in a fresh context, without CLAUDE.md, memory or hook context, then you switch back with nothing lost.

switchMode.title: Switch mode for bare /fresheye
switchMode.description: ask: confirm before switching (default). toggle: switch at once. off: never switch, only show where the other conversation is.

confirmTimeoutSeconds.title: Confirmation timeout (seconds)
confirmTimeoutSeconds.description: With no answer in this time, FreshEye stays in the current conversation. 5 to 600.
